the_chain.statement: To explain permission slips, you have to explain YCYOR. To explain YCYOR, you have to explain the Art of Allowing. To explain the Art of Allowing, you have to explain beliefs. The whole chain is necessary to explain permission slips.

concept.name: Beliefs
concept.definition: You cannot have an experience you don't believe in. The total of everything you believe in is the Field.
concept.growing_and_shrinking: To experience things outside your beliefs, you must believe in them. Then the Field grows. To stop experiencing certain things, you can drop beliefs, which decreases the Field.
concept.movement: Belief work is constant movement: letting go, putting on, letting go, putting on, until the believer is holding the frequencies you are trying to get to. "Like a Rubik's cube type of weaving."

concept.name: The Believer
concept.nature: A teaching device Dlozi uses to explain how beliefs work. Not a claim about a literal creature.
concept.description: A creature that is a tool. Not good, not bad. Like a living toaster: it keeps itself alive and does what it does. What it is great at is holding on to frequencies.
concept.mechanism: It leverages your own experiences in those frequencies to create a braid, which is easier to hold on to than singular vibrational strings. It uses the memories that are beneficial to it to reinforce holding on to a certain vibration.
concept.use_case: You use a believer especially in a dense dimension, where you need to constantly hold on to the vibration of density and don't want to let go of it suddenly. You are playing with a lot of frequencies, like weaving with your fingers, holding some threads with some fingers while pulling others. You give the believer certain frequencies and say: hold on to these for me and reinforce them. "Make sure I hold on to this body."
concept.neutrality: Whether a belief is positive or negative, the believer doesn't care. A toaster doesn't tell you it's toasting wrong. Neither does a believer.
concept.why_letting_go_is_hard: It is not because of the negative beliefs. It is because the believer is just doing a job. "You said I must hold on to this. I didn't know this was bad. You said, I held on." So the work of letting go is required.

concept.name: The Field
concept.definition: The hundred percent: all that you believe in. What you can experience is limited to what your believer is holding when all of it is put together. "You can't be cooking with frequencies you ain't gots."
concept.term_note: "The Field" is the correct word. Use it as Dlozi's term with her meaning.

concept.name: The Art of Allowing
concept.definition: From the whole of the Field, we usually allow ourselves a sliver. You are the one who decides which portion of your hundred percent you experience. That chunk you've said you will experience: that is allowing.
concept.distinction: The Field is what you believe in. Allowing is the sliver of it you let yourself experience. Do not collapse the two.
concept.possibility: You can experience your hundred percent, a hundred percent of the time.

concept.name: YCYOR
concept.position_in_chain: Between the Art of Allowing and permission slips.
concept.definition: Not yet dictated in this material. Ask Dlozi.

concept.name: Permission Slips
concept.definition: Access cards to parts of the Field outside the usual allowance.

prior_positions.position: Permission slips are beliefs first, long before they take form.
Tools hold no power. They give access to power you already have.
Permission slips are the UI; spirit is the backend.
The teaching is the belief-to-form pipeline, not the objects.

working_rules.rule: When the framework does not cover something, ask Dlozi. Do not fill the gap with general spiritual, new age or manifestation teaching.
Use Dlozi's terms exactly: the Field, the Believer, allowing, permission slips, YCYOR. Do not swap in synonyms or AI vocabulary.
When explaining permission slips to anyone new, build from beliefs upward in the teaching order.
When asking Dlozi a question, ask it clean. Do not attach a suggested answer.
